loc-1765980350720-ugqavlju8.name: The Moon

dna.looks: AERIAL/SATELLITE VIEW: The Moon as a desolate, cratered orb with stark light and shadow. Distant Earth hangs as a jewel in the blackness. No individual structures are visible, only vast plains and shadowed craters.
dna.colorsAndLighting: Harsh, high-contrast sunlight creates deep shadows. The primary color is an omnipresent lunar gray, with the vibrant blue and white of Earth as a striking, distant accent.
dna.atmosphere: A vacuum. The sky is an absolute, star-filled black. No weather or atmospheric diffusion.
dna.materials: Dominant lunar regolith (dust and rock), with hints of metallic sheen from subsurface materials in select, distant geological formations.
dna.mood: Utter solitude, ancient stillness, and cosmic indifference. A sense of immense scale and emptiness.
dna.sounds: Absolute silence, broken only by the faint hum of a spacecraft or internal ship noises.
dna.secondary_surfaces: Crater rims, mountain ranges, shadowed abysses.
dna.ambient: Stark, direct sunlight and the black void of space.
dna.palette_bias: Monochromatic with a distant color anomaly

loc-1765980350720-ugqavlju8.description: A vast, desolate sphere of gray dust and rock, illuminated by the distant, brilliant Earth. Craters scar its surface, and the stark, shadow-drenched plains stretch towards an inky black sky.
loc-1765980350720-ugqavlju8.searchDesc: Barren lunar surface, craters, distant Earth view.

structure.spatialLayout: Dominated by vast, flat plains, ancient impact craters of varying sizes, and mountain ranges casting long shadows.

5d0841cc-cf38-492e-bd8b-79558bc7c0a7.name: Lunar Orbital Forge

dna.looks: The Lunar Orbital Forge is a monumental edifice sculpted from the lunar crust, its exterior a rugged expanse of metallic plating and extruded structures. It appears as a series of interconnected modules and vast excavation sites, designed for sheer industrial capacity. The scale is immense, dwarfing any human-made structures.
dna.colorsAndLighting: Dominated by the muted grays and ochres of the lunar regolith, accented by the dull sheen of weathered metallic alloys. Industrial lighting casts stark, long shadows across the surfaces, with occasional bursts of intense, functional spotlights within openings.
dna.atmosphere: The air is thin and sterile within enclosed areas, a constant hum of powerful machinery pervading the environment. Temperature fluctuates wildly between direct sunlight and shadow, though internal climate control is likely rigorous. A sense of immense, ongoing labor pervades.
dna.materials: The primary materials are reinforced, dark metallic alloys and compressed lunar regolith. Textures are rough and functional, with visible seams, rivets, and extruded conduits. Surfaces are generally weathered, bearing the marks of cosmic radiation and micrometeorite impacts.
dna.mood: A mood of awe-inspiring, relentless productivity and alien ingenuity. The forge evokes a sense of insignificance against its vast, functional power.
dna.sounds: Low hum, metallic clanks, distant grinding, pressurized hiss, rhythmic thuds.
dna.secondary_surfaces: Exposed conduits, reinforced struts, heavy-duty hatches
dna.accent_features: Glow of internal machinery visible through openings, directional spotlights, subtle panel lines.
dna.dominant: Gray (70%) - lunar regolith and general metallic structures
dna.secondary: Dark Charcoal (20%) - reinforced plating and structural elements
dna.accent: Dull Orange/Yellow (5%) - internal machinery glow, hazard markings
dna.cultural_tone: Designed for large-scale extraterrestrial spacecraft construction, prioritizing function and durability.
dna.palette_bias: Monochromatic greys and muted earth tones

5d0841cc-cf38-492e-bd8b-79558bc7c0a7.description: A sprawling, utilitarian alien factory built into the lunar regolith, designed for constructing spacecraft. EXTERIOR VIEW.
5d0841cc-cf38-492e-bd8b-79558bc7c0a7.searchDesc: Sprawling alien factory built into the moon, constructing spacecraft. Utilitarian and massive.

structure.spatialLayout: The forge is an expansive complex, largely subterranean or excavated into the lunar surface. Its layout is dictated by function, with vast open manufacturing bays and a network of utility tunnels and access corridors.

navigableElements.description: Leads into the main manufacturing bay, a vast, cavernous interior filled with industrial machinery.
A smaller, reinforced opening that seems to lead to personnel quarters or administrative areas.
An external maintenance path winding around the primary structure, offering views of the surrounding lunar terrain.

dominantElements: factory: utilitarian, colossal, exterior, regolith, reinforced metal plates, industrial lighting
gates: colossal, exterior, steel alloy, reinforced plating, dim ambient light
